useCases.name: Mobile Number validations using OTP
useCases.desc: We will validate the user's mobile number by sending OTP via SMS that they must enter to complete registration or login.

useCases.name: Foget MPIN
useCases.desc: Users can reset their forgotten MPIN by verifying their identity through an OTP sent to their registered mobile number.

useCases.name: Payment Completion
useCases.desc: We will send an immediate payment completion confirmation message via APN and SMS to the user once their transaction is successfully processed.
useCases.pre:
SMS and APN channel must be active.
App integration needs to be done.
Templates to be active on Netcore.

useCases.name: Payment completion - Subscription & Payments Enhancements
useCases.desc: We will send SMS and email for all new subscriptions, renewals, and upgraded payment transactions.
useCases.pre:
Email, SMS channel must be active.
Templates to be created on Netcore.

useCases.name: General Alerts & Notifications
useCases.desc: We will trigger real-time, APN and SMS alerts to instantly notify users of critical system events, and account actions like an MPIN failure.
useCases.pre:
SMS and APN channel must be active.
App integration needs to be done.
Templates to be created on Netcore.

useCases.name: Learning

useCases.pre:
APN channel must be active.
App integration needs to be done.
Templates to be created on Netcore.

useCases.name: Referral

Templates to be created on Netcore.

useCases.name: User Profile
